reproduction_python:
# Offline only; original stored sensor and body timestamps are never changed.
# Identity IMU mount and filter sizes 1 are verified in original sealed config.
# Associate a native f32 timestamp only with its uniquely nearest original
# 2 ms tick; measured max residual 458 ns is far below a half-tick. Do not
# interpolate pose or substitute this diagnostic key into published records.
def rotation_xyzw(q):
    q=np.asarray(q,dtype=float);q=q/np.linalg.norm(q);x,y,z,w=q
    return np.array([[1-2*(y*y+z*z),2*(x*y-z*w),2*(x*z+y*w)],
      [2*(x*y+z*w),1-2*(x*x+z*z),2*(y*z-x*w)],
      [2*(x*z-y*w),2*(y*z+x*w),1-2*(x*x+y*y)]])
def audit(directory):
    body=rows(directory/'trajectory.jsonl')
    imu=rows(directory/'imu_readings.jsonl')
    keyed={round(r['sim_time_ns']/2_000_000)*2_000_000:r for r in imu}
    assert len(keyed)==len(imu)
    residual=max(abs(r['sim_time_ns']-round(r['sim_time_ns']/2_000_000)*2_000_000) for r in imu)
    assert residual<1_000_000
    matched=[]
    for b in body:
      i=keyed.get(b['sim_time_ns'])
      if i is None:continue
      qb=np.asarray(b['pose'][3:],dtype=float);qi=np.asarray(i['orientation_xyzw'],dtype=float)
      dot=abs(float((qb/np.linalg.norm(qb))@(qi/np.linalg.norm(qi))))
      qe=float(2*np.arccos(min(1.,dot)))
      predicted=rotation_xyzw(qb).T@np.asarray(b['angular_velocity_world'])
      we=float(np.linalg.norm(predicted-np.asarray(i['angular_velocity'])))
      matched.append((qe,we,b,i))
    def stats(v):return dict(min=min(v),median=statistics.median(v),max=max(v))
    changes=[r['sim_time_ns'] for n,r in enumerate(imu) if n and r['orientation_xyzw']!=imu[n-1]['orientation_xyzw']]
    worst=max(matched,key=lambda r:r[0])
    return dict(body_samples=len(body),imu_output_samples=len(imu),same_physics_tick_body_matches=len(matched),
      native_f32_stamp_nearest_tick_max_abs_residual_ns=residual,
      unique_orientation_values=len({tuple(r['orientation_xyzw']) for r in imu}),
      orientation_value_changes=len(changes),first_orientation_change_source_ns=changes[:8],
      orientation_error_rad=stats([r[0] for r in matched]),
      body_frame_angular_velocity_error_radps=stats([r[1] for r in matched]),
      worst_orientation_example=dict(body_source_ns=worst[2]['sim_time_ns'],native_imu_source_ns=worst[3]['sim_time_ns'],
        original_body_pose=worst[2]['pose'],original_world_angular_velocity=worst[2]['angular_velocity_world'],
        original_imu=worst[3],orientation_error_rad=worst[0],angular_error_radps=worst[1]))

def audit_imu_phase(directory, reference_directory):
    body=rows(directory/'trajectory.jsonl');imu=rows(directory/'imu_readings.jsonl')
    ref_body=rows(reference_directory/'trajectory.jsonl');ref_imu=rows(reference_directory/'imu_readings.jsonl')
    keyed={round(r['sim_time_ns']/2_000_000)*2_000_000:r for r in imu}
    phase=[];gyro=[]
    for b in body:
      i=keyed.get(b['sim_time_ns'])
      if i is not None:
        predicted=rotation_xyzw(i['orientation_xyzw']).T@np.asarray(b['angular_velocity_world'])
        gyro.append(float(np.linalg.norm(predicted-np.asarray(i['angular_velocity']))))
      if b['sim_time_ns']%100_000_000!=18_000_000:continue
      i=keyed.get(b['sim_time_ns']+2_000_000)
      if i is None:continue
      qb=np.asarray(b['pose'][3:]);qi=np.asarray(i['orientation_xyzw'])
      dot=abs(float((qb/np.linalg.norm(qb))@(qi/np.linalg.norm(qi))))
      phase.append(float(2*np.arccos(min(1.,dot))))
    capture=[(x,y) for x,y in zip(imu,ref_imu)
      if round(x['sim_time_ns']/2_000_000)*2_000_000%100_000_000==20_000_000]
    return dict(actual_BEGIN_to_native_IMU_END_matches=len(phase),
      orientation_BEGIN_END_error_rad=dict(min=min(phase),median=statistics.median(phase),max=max(phase)),
      same_tick_world_gyro_rotated_by_original_IMU_frame_matches=len(gyro),
      gyro_in_original_IMU_frame_error_radps=dict(min=min(gyro),median=statistics.median(gyro),max=max(gyro)),
      complete_raw_body_trajectory_literal_equal_to_reference=body==ref_body,
      original_IMU_source_ns_array_literal_equal_to_reference=[r['sim_time_ns'] for r in imu]==[r['sim_time_ns'] for r in ref_imu],
      capture_tick_records=len(capture),capture_tick_orientation_literal_equal=sum(x['orientation_xyzw']==y['orientation_xyzw'] for x,y in capture),
      capture_tick_gyro_literal_equal=sum(x['angular_velocity']==y['angular_velocity'] for x,y in capture),
      scope='Native orientation uses the original actual BEGIN transform and native END stamp; compare original phase, not demand post-step body quaternion equality or restamp.')
